description: A Tauri Windows app feels frozen when resizing because of old Tauri/WebView2 resize performance and window effect behavior, from https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/issues/6322.
prompt: My desktop app feels like the computer is crashing whenever I drag-resize the window on Windows. It is smooth enough on Linux and the UI itself is just a tiny vanilla page, so I don't know where to look.
